$comment: The brand marks, pinned by sha256. `brand-doctor` rule 9 fails if any
All eleven files are rendered by `scripts/generate-brand-marks.ts` from
the same two vector sources — the Geist wordmark and the drawn Q inspection mark —
each at its own native resolution, not resized from one bitmap master.
`masters` names the two large reference renders (the full wordmark
lockup and the square inspection mark alone); `derived` is every size a real
surface consumes. The split is nominal now, not a resize lineage, but
the point of pinning both groups is unchanged: a regenerated file with
different numbers is still a change to what a reader sees, and it
should arrive as a decision, not a diff nobody reads.
To change one deliberately: edit generate-brand-marks.ts (or its font
inputs), run `npm run brand:marks` then `npm run brand:marks:update`,
and say why in the commit.
